description: This image is a ground-level photograph depicting a man-made, rectangular reservoir with light blue water and visible retaining walls, situated in a hilly, semi-arid landscape on the Canary Island, Spain. The surrounding terrain features slopes covered with green vegetation, intermixed with lighter, possibly agricultural, areas. Scattered buildings and winding dirt roads are visible in the background and on adjacent hillsides. The photograph serves to illustrate the correct method for delimiting man-made water bodies in land cover mapping by using the current water level. The image is credited to M. Palacios.
